description: Minecraft client Mod - Toggle sneak & sprint. Requires Fabric

mods.name: Zebra's Toggle Sneak&Sprint
mods.description:
Sneak and sprint keys behave as if they can be locked into the pressed state and unlocked by pressing them again.
 The toggle function can be enabled/disabled ingame by pressing other configurable keys. Have a look into the Controls section.
 Some extras:
  + No toggle if key is pressed longer than key hold time
  + Setting key hold time to 0 ticks will disable hold function
  + No sneak toggle if dismounting or flying
  + Flying speed can be boosted in creative mode by hitting the sprint key.
 
 A tip from BlauesZebra: Have a look at Shotbow's Minecraft servers at us.shotbow.net and eu.shotbow.net.
 You'll find this mod useful in all the great game modes there like Annihilation, MTA or MineZ
 See you at Shotbow soon!
